rows.en: ＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿０２４Hello! I was looking for you.＝＠１６８＿０２５While I was researching Elan, I￥found some really beautiful￥footage...
＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿０２６Um, if you don't mind... would￥you come watch it with me?
＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿０２８I see... That's too bad.＝＠１６８＿０２９Then I'll go watch it alone.￥Goodbye...
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿００１Here it is.￥On this big monitor, it looked￥really beautiful.
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿００２So I really wanted to watch it￥with you...
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿００３I thought if I saw it with you,￥it might look more beautiful￥than when I watched it alone...＝＠１６９＿００４I'm not sure why, but I did.
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿００５Embarrassed?￥I just felt like it would look￥more beautiful with you...＝＠１６９＿００６Did that... bother you?
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿００７What a relief.＝＠１６９＿００８I didn't know what I'd do if you￥said it did...
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿００９I'm sorry. I don't want to make￥you feel bad.＝＠１６９＿０１０Thank you for coming all this￥way with me.＝...
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿０１１I...＝＠１６９＿０１２If I see you, I'm sure I'll end￥up saying something that bothers￥you again.
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿０１５It was something you said that￥got me looking into Elan.＝＠１６９＿０１６And every time I met you after￥that, I got curious about more￥and more things.
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿０１７I owe so much of it to you...
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿０１８I was built to go to Elan.
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿０１９But in the end, they gave up on￥me and threw me away like￥trash...＝＠１６９＿０２０When they threw me away, I￥didn't feel a thing. Not sad,￥not hurt...
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿０２１But now, I think it's sad.＝＠１６９＿０２２I really do have feelings.
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿０２３Having feelings is amazing.＝＠１６９＿０２４You feel bad, painful things￥too, but...＝＠１６９＿０２５even more than that, you get to￥feel happy and have fun!
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿０２７Yes! Because I never knew￥feelings like this even existed.
＊Sarai＊＠１６９＿０２８Yes!＝＠１６９＿０２９Because I never used to feel￥happy like this before.
＊Sarai＊＠１７０＿００１I want to go to Elan.＝＠１７０＿００２I'm an android built for Elan￥experiments, but...＝＠１７０＿００３now I want to go because I￥choose to. I really, really do!!
＊Sarai＊＠１７０＿００４Well... Elan is so beautiful,￥and I think my abilities could￥be useful there...
＊Sarai＊＠１７０＿００６An android that was already￥thrown away once...＝＠１７０＿００７would never be trusted with such￥important work...
＊Sarai＊＠１７０＿００９And more than anything...￥because you're going to Elan...
＊Sarai＊＠１７０＿０１０It might be impossible... but￥I'll try my best to find a way￥to go.
＊Sarai＊＠１７０＿０１１Because you're the reason I have￥feelings and emotions...
＊Sarai＊＠１７０＿０１２I don't want to be scrapped￥ever again!
＊Sarai＊＠１７０＿０１６Is this... a tear?＝...＝＠１７０＿０１７I can cry too...＝＠１７０＿０１８Thank you.￥It's all thanks to you.
